name: The Avenger Deathmatch: Luke Skywalker vs. Neo

date.source: The site's own copyright line (1999) on both documents describing this matchup; the site's own text frames it as "This week's main event," so the capture date is this matchup's own billed week, not necessarily the site's founding year.

appearances.note: Billed "A Super Sci-Fi Slobberknocker" against Neo on the dedicated Deathmatch page; restated as "The Battle Of The Summer Sci-Fi Box Office Hits" on the front page.

notes: The held record's one surviving matchup — held twice over, in two documents' own words (the-avenger-deathmatch.html, the-front-page.html), but not the result: both documents point their own "CLICK HERE TO SEE THE MATCH" link at a separate GeoCities account (avengerweb) never captured in this holding, so the outcome is unresolved rather than a draw or no-contest. No card, roster, or title structure survives around this one matchup — the corpus holds no other.
